neighbours.label: ' three', ' two' or ' several' in a small count before ' different' or a plural noun (three different views, several different values), firing on the count word; other determiners stay low
fire: The review compares the plan from three different angles.
Things get messy when several different rules apply.
Students get feedback from two separate teachers.
The story is told from three different points of view.
She has worked in several different countries since college.
We tried two different brands before finding a good one.
The fossil was found in three distinct layers of rock.
They asked several different experts about the bridge.
quiet: The review compares the plan from every possible angle.
Things get messy when no clear rules apply.
Students get feedback from their own teachers.
The story is told from a child's point of view.
She has worked in many countries since college.
We tried other brands before finding a good one.
The fossil was found in soft layers of rock.
They asked the local experts about the bridge.
